## FA-011 / ZEUS-74e61b578afa revision 1 — Refs #12

### Defect (upstream, agreed in cross-review)
Copying the template's `quality_axes_enforced: true   # ...` verbatim made the upstream parser read the whole line as the value, so enforcement was off and the real CLI printed `inspected=0` PASS; list normalization and missing-section verdicts also differed from the docs, and the 9 upstream unit tests did not prevent it. Consensus: explicit input schema/parser, copyable examples verified, and a quality result contract binding scope, counts, skip/not_run/fail/pass and code/input/policy identity.

### The same defect in Zeus
`adapters/skill_routing.frontmatter()` was a flat `key: value` line parser. Measured: `keywords: [alpha, beta]   # 주석` split into `['[alpha,', 'beta]', '#', '주석']` (silent mismatch); `min_score: 2  # note` raised `Invalid skill minimum score` and aborted the whole context assembly; the routing summary had no inspected count.

### Change
- `frontmatter()` now uses `project_skills.load_yaml` (string-only, no tags, unique keys, size/expansion bounds): scalars stay strings, inline lists become string lists, empty → `''`, nested/tagged/list-root/non-string items fail explicitly. Same function serves `native_routing_replay`.
- `domain/skill_ranking.split_list_field` accepts parsed lists (quote stripping only) and rejects non-strings; `skill_guidance` consumers follow.
- `route_skills()` summary adds `inspected` beside `matched/full/pointers/legacy`, `objective_hash`, `threshold_definition`/`policy` and `admission_model`.
- `load_yaml(text, label)` message label (identical to the FA-002 branch; merges cleanly).
- `docs/contracts.md` (`INV-SKILL-001`), `docs/zeus/implementation/skill-metadata-gate-001/README.md`.

### Verification
| | Result |
|---|---|
| `test_inline_comments_never_enter_matcher_values`: commented template shape parses clean and `score_skill` yields `(True, 2, [intent, kw])` | pass |
| `test_malformed_skill_metadata_fails_explicitly` (×6: nested, list-in-list, duplicate key, `!!python` tag, list root, broken YAML) | pass |
| `test_routing_summary_reports_inspected_count_so_zero_matches_are_not_unchecked` (2/1/1; 0 of 2; 0 of 0) | pass |
| Negative control: revert `skill_routing.py`/`skill_ranking.py` to `origin/main` | 7 of the new checks fail |
| `test_skill_routing`, `test_skill_guidance`, `test_native_routing_replay`, `test_project_skills`, `test_skill_history` | 58 passed, 1 skipped |
| Windows full `uv run pytest -q` (Python 3.12.14) / `ruff check` | 925 passed, 305 skipped / clean |
| Linux path | this PR's ubuntu CI matrix |

### Not claimed
Zeus has no per-axis skill quality checker (upstream G1–G9) and none is added; this PR fixes the parser and the summary contract, and what a quality PASS means stays a separate design. Monitor/audit CLI display of `inspected` is follow-up. Issue closure follows the ledger acceptance path (#30) and is a separate step after this PR; the GitHub issue stays OPEN until that acceptance.
